notes.title: Patch Notes for 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We have had some questions from the community regarding what changed since the latest Early Access release compared to the 1.0 full release that is now available. 



There were tons of tons of things that we touched, refined, reworked and added to the game, but to give you all a nice and tidy overview, we have compiled the following list.


Changes
Reworked the entire player journey with now over 40 levels in 3 stages
New Features
Added new interactive tutorial

Finalized "The Electric Ruins"

Added new bosses

Added the final boss

Added story cut scenes

Added new modules

Added more special level chunks
Fixes
Everything! (but if the multiverse still collapses here or there, please get in touch!)



Thank you very much for your support!



The Rarebyte Team

notes.title: "The Electric Ruins" Update
notes.content:
Hello Space Cadets!

We are super proud to announce the release of our newest We Are Screwed! update! A new Universe is now available: The Electric Ruins. The update includes the first two areas of the Ruins, as well as its Corrupted version, the Ruined Ruins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/680a318481507d524920bf9d72765805c6e2a265.gif

These new maps will unveil new quests and NPCs, as well as new enemies and, of course, terrifying bosses! But don’t worry, you’ll get new Modules to deal with them. Also, be ready to deal with even more chaos inside the ship as we are introducing the Power Outage! Talking about ships, there is a new one to discover and it has a very silly interior and some unique gameplay... will you find it? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/ced1c47ae03fa4a6ada3bf55d092ee5c0262ca9d.gif

We can’t wait for you to see what we’ve prepared for you, and we dearly hope you enjoy it! We would love to hear your feedback and thoughts on our game, it helps us greatly to improve it and add more exciting content. Therefore, we would like to invite you to follow us on social media, which we are regularly monitoring, and would love to communicate with you there, as well as our Discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/010bbe1f864bdd46bc32a1f3d88fdbdf4748ac23.gif

Follow us below:

Website | Facebook | Instagram |  Twitter | TikTok | YouTube | Discord

We hope you enjoy this update!

Safe Manoeuvres! 
Your team at Rarebyte

notes.title: "The Corrupted Rifts" Update
notes.content:
Hello Space Cadets!

We’re happy to announce that we have dropped another We Are Screwed! update for you. The Corrupted Rifts update introduces side missions that take players into twisted universes, where they need to deliver a Corrupted Module before it overheats and destroys the ship. These timed challenges consist of multiple levels where players will be able to test their skills in fast-paced missions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/8254bd440697c6d4facff05821a74f08969642ab.gif

The goal of Corrupted Rifts missions is to deliver the dangerous cargo to “The Sealer'', the only being in the multiverse who can defuse it. This rat-like creature will generously reward players with module variants, passive modules and in-game currency. Full update notes can be read below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/c11a4f2b7a3595c4f95357eee26249cdbe3c5d0a.gif

We can’t wait for you to see what we’ve prepared for you, and we dearly hope you enjoy it! As a developer, we would love to hear your feedback and thoughts on our game, it helps us greatly to improve it and add more exciting content. Therefore, we would like to invite you to follow us on social media, which we are regularly monitoring and would love to communicate with you there, as well as our Discord

notes.title: We Are Screwed! Roadmap Reveal!
notes.content:
Greetings, Space Cadets!

It's been almost two months since We Are Screwed! launched into Early Access, and we know you are eager to discover what's next! The crew gathered in the Terra Space Station and created a roadmap, which we are excited to share today. Take a look below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/1a059ef827bcb9a1b4858a5362aac1201d436b3f.png

The game has already been updated with one major update and several smaller patches to fix and balance the game based on the community's feedback, and we will continue to do so. We are very thankful for any kind of feedback and bug reports posted in the comment section, forum posts, reviews, and on social media! We look forward to improving the game based on your feedback and bringing you the next We Are Screwed! update!

PLAYING WITH FRIENDS REMOTELY
Inviting a Space Cadet from another universe can be quite a journey, but it shouldn't be difficult! We reworked the menu to give you a better explanation of how to invite your friends through Steam Remote Play and Parsec.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/b3ea6dea17bebc0e16c26fe590b2b0b7db57515d.png

That's all for today, Space Cadets!

notes.title: The First Update is LIVE
notes.content:
Suit up, Space Cadets! The first update of We Are Screwed! just launched and we have packed a bunch of other out-of-this-world announcements! Put your Extravehicular Visor Assembly on and let's take a closer look..

F[reakingly] Big Space Gun
https://i.imgur.com/S1cytac.gif
Charge up a big plasma ball with the F-BSG turret that once fired, will zap nearby enemies for significant amounts of damage! The key to operating the F-BSG Module is to shoot the plasma ball close to the enemies while also avoiding hitting them.


Mine Launcher
https://i.imgur.com/WjX0UZl.gif
The Mine Launcher launches up to 5 mines into space, that work exactly like the regular mines. Using the Mine Launcher, you can create minefields and traps for enemies or use them for chaining up an explosive surprise. Be sure to keep your distance though, these mines can hit your spaceship with a mighty blast!


Enemy Groups
https://i.imgur.com/ZJ7BUPT.gif
Some enemies prefer hanging out in groups with a bigger, faster, and tankier Leader in their midst! These groups will be randomly generated depending on the level and have a possibility to be marked. Taking out every single enemy of a marked group will reward you with awesome equipment! 


Hands Off Turret
https://i.imgur.com/2q5dpbj.gif
This turret reflects enemy projectiles back towards them: You basically shoot them with their own bullets! PS: It can also be used to push enemies away a bit. Into a pit. In space.


That's not all!
Verified on Steam Deck!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/bb3ce6daa8211fb9a74a2ae074e81754d67fb32d.png
We're over the moon to announce that We Are Screwed! is now Verified on the Steam Deck! Check it out and let us know how it runs!


And to make this update even more stellar.. 
First Update (and a little bit of Easter) Sale!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630124/ac3c75f7058ac3c2dea377e5e5ffb810d5449d8c.png
We Are Screwed! is now officially 15% off until Sunday, April 9th! If you're up for the challenge of going on an intergalactic adventure alone or with fellow crewmates, now is the best time.
